gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-hepta-slab: Neuropol looks like a digital readout, slim and single-weight with a narrow channel where the c opens, while Hepta Slab stretches out beside it, bookish and dignified. Body text could sit a notch smaller.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads editorial and traditional, its serif terminals stopping well short of the stem and the letterspacing generous. And Neuropol, futuristic and closed up, gives the page a sharp digital header above it.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-padyakke-expanded: Neuropol is a slim, single-weight outline face with a narrow channel where the c opens, very digital. And Padyakke Expanded One, a text serif spread wide like knots on a slack rope, gives it a literary, authoritative counterweight.
gen-dafont-neuropol-gf-stint-ultra-expan: Futuristic is the first word for Neuropol, closed and outline-like, while Stint Ultra Expanded lets each character float apart with open counters leading outward. One feels sealed, the other loose.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-domine: Neuropolitical pulls its letters apart one by one, neon-tube lines glowing at a single thickness with big open counters. Domine follows in a serif that thickens slightly like a reed pen, so paragraphs feel refined and dignified.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-esteban: Level, spaced-out and neon-bright, that is Neuropolitical, drawing every stroke at a single thickness with no modulation at all. But Esteban, a text serif with moderately modulated strokes and a wide-open e, is the one built to carry the reading.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-faustina: Pulled-apart letters glow like neon tubes in Neuropolitical, each drawn by a fixed-width nib, which makes it a strong header voice. Faustina, a text serif with graceful thinning bowls, handles the reading.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-halant: Neon-tube letters with no hairlines and no swelling anywhere, that is Neuropolitical's whole look up top. And Halant, a text serif with a faint thick-thin shift and a towering x-height, could take a slightly smaller size.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-headland-on: Headland One is a traditional, dignified serif with letters set well apart and a tall rounded o, and Neuropolitical sits over it in glowing single-width neon lines. The two feel like old and new.
gen-dafont-neuropolitical-gf-hedvig-lett: Hedvig Letters Serif reads authoritative and classic, with open-ended curves, sturdy tall lowercase and a middle-of-the-road contrast between strokes. Neuropolitical's neon-tube letters feel starker beside it.
